id: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days (2003)

facts.text: Ten days, one column. Tonight I'm cooking him something awful and he has to eat every bite with a smile.
facts.why: Andie never cooks Ben a terrible dinner in the plot read. Her tricks are the Knicks game, the scrapbook, Princess Sophia, the love fern, the poker night and the puppy.
facts.fix: Ten days, one column. Tonight Ben meets my worst habits, and he has to say he loves every one.

facts.text: Ben's family card game. Bluff the last round.
facts.why: Ben's poker night with Tony and Thayer plays Bullshit with Andie, but the Staten Island family weekend has no card game.
facts.fix: Ben's poker night. Bluff the last round.

facts.why: The pitch is for a diamond company, with the line 'A diamond is for everyone', and no pink diamond comes up.
